scenes.title: Volumetric Knot
scenes.text: Well, the wave can't escape anymore. It's not just a jump rope waving forward. The spatial spasm becomes trapped in its own 3D non -commutative geometry. So it wraps space -time back on itself. Exactly.

scenes.title: Volumetric Knot
scenes.text: It creates a localized topological knot. Which raises a huge, huge question. What actually is mass? In this framework, it's just pure geometry. The entrapped spatial energy condenses into rest mass.

scenes.title: Volumetric Knot
scenes.text: That's E equals MC squared. So matter isn't some separate stuff placed into empty space. Matter is literally an active knotting of 3D space itself. It resolves wave particle duality completely. That is so elegant.
